preferences.style_guidance: Use simple kitchen-sharing analogies without changing the mathematical facts.

scenes.title: What Is a Fraction?
scenes.objective: Explain the numerator and denominator of a fraction.

source_excerpts.text: A fraction represents a part of a whole. The top number is the numerator. The bottom number is the denominator and shows how many equal parts the whole is divided into.

scenes.title: Adding Like Fractions
scenes.objective: Add fractions that share the same denominator.

source_excerpts.text: To add fractions with the same denominator, add the numerators and keep the denominator unchanged. One fifth plus two fifths equals three fifths.
